profile.headline: Exciting title about how awesome I am at developing software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building things, deleting code, and teaching Angular/TypeScript.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Built finsight.com - a unique platform to allow instant and easy access to bond market data.  Product includes an intuitive UI and a backend data pipeline to extract meaningful insights from raw data published by the SEC and other sources.  Lead the migration of existing DealRoadshow products from "pet" servers to a scalable container based architecture.  Finalized the migrations of dataroom products to new platform using modern best practices.  Maintained, supported, and secured production servers and services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Google's internal system to handle and manage large scale data center disruptions.  I improved the system's ability to allow users to appropriately estimate the risk of events impacting productions data centers.  I created a system to visualize and understand how concurrent events around the globe interact with each other and integrated the system with an automated network risk assessment tool to mitigate human errors.

Google Cloud Deployment Manager is an API for creating repeatable automated deployments on the Google Cloud platform.  I built the frontend allowing users to view deployments, their details, and statuses in a logical hierarchy, delete deployments, and create new deployments from "Click to Deploy" solutions, such as Hadoop, Cassandra, and MongoDB.

Big fun stuff :)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My major contribution at SnapRetail was the development of their next generation drag and drop content editor.  This is the central piece of the product that allows customers to easily create and design websites and marketing emails, either from scratch or from templates.  I got to do a lot of other fun stuff too.

positions.title: Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description: Mobile game company I founded targeting Android, Blackberry, Kindle, and Nook.  Began expansion to iOS but ceased operations before release to join Google.

positions.title: Founder, Software Developer
positions.description: AndroidBlowout was a flash deal retail website specializing in Android devices at a low price point.  I developed the online store, purchased inventory, and maintained the site until ceasing operations.

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description: Money4iPhone was an independent consumer electronics refurbisher.  I built their online presence facilitating the purchasing of used mobile devices directly from consumers with backend systems to automate shipping logistics and manage their lead funnel.

positions.title: Database Software Developer
positions.description: Over my three years at Barnum Financial Group, I was able to overhaul their data systems by developing streamlined line of business applications.  I had a huge impact on the technical direction of the firm, allowing the development of an experimental program that generated $3,332,060 in revenue during its first year of operation.

positions.title: Bassist
positions.description: It was an awesome band with a bunch of awesome guys.  I moved out of state, they kept rocking for a while, then had a great sendoff.

positions.title: Student Teacher - Math, Computer Science
positions.description: I showed kids how awesome and empowering programming is by letting them create games to learn material.  I authored software to make learning conic functions less boring for algebra students.  I also taught a little bit.
